body.title: Expose the task-count check
body.summary: Add an exported function that returns the INV-13 PlanValidationFailure for a plan or null, using the leaf module's band and lower bound and the same message and target as today, and make validatePlan call it at its existing INV-13 position without changing any result.
acceptanceChecks: for every scope XS..XL, focused and not, at lo-1, lo, hi and hi+1, the function and validatePlan agree on INV-13 (message and target included), with one exception: an empty plan (0 tasks, reached only at lo-1 for focused XS), where validatePlan reports INV-1 first, as it does today, and the function alone reports INV-13
validatePlan invariant order and results are unchanged for the existing validator tests

tests.name: src/analyze/planner/__tests__/validate.test.ts: the task-count check agrees with validatePlan at every band boundary
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/validate.test.ts: validatePlan keeps its invariant order and results for the existing cases
